content: <thought>We need a template that, when applied retrosynthetically to the sulfonamide product “Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)O)cc2)cc1”, yields the two precursors “Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)O)cc2)cc1” (the sulfonyl‑chloride fragment) and “c1ccccc1N” (aniline). The search for templates breaking a sulfonamide returned several candidates. I tested template 827966 and 827968; neither gave the required precursor set. I will now test the remaining candidate templates from the search results until I find the one that produces exactly the desired precursor pair.
